defensiveAbilities.name: Meltdown
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The irradiated undead plant is reduced to 0 Hit Points by energy damage of any kind

Effect The energy acts as a catalyst for a nuclear reaction, causing the plant to explode and dealing 9d6 Poison Damage damage to all creatures in a 20ft Type:emanation with a Basic DC 24 Reflex Saving Throw save.

defensiveAbilities.name: Radioactive Remains
defensiveAbilities.description: 20 feet. A creature entering or starting its turn inside the aura is exposed to extreme radiation.

defensiveAbilities.name: Void Healing
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

A creature with void healing draws health from void energy rather than vitality energy. It is damaged by vitality damage and is not healed by vitality healing effects. It does not take void damage, and it is healed by void effects that heal undead.

offensiveAbilities.name: Charged Burst
offensiveAbilities.description: The irradiated charger triggers a localized radioactive reaction as it charges. It Strides once and then Strikes. A creature damaged by this attack takes 1 additional point of void damage for every space the charger moved prior to making its Strike. On a critical hit, the creature is also knocked Prone.

offensiveAbilities.name: Trample
offensiveAbilities.description:
Medium or smaller, Tusk, Basic DC 24 Reflex Saving Throw

See rules...

The monster Strides up to double its Speed and can move through the spaces of creatures of the listed size, Trampling each creature whose space it enters. The monster can attempt to Trample the same creature only once in a single use of Trample. The monster deals the damage of the listed Strike, but trampled creatures can attempt a basic Reflex save at the listed DC (no damage on a critical success, half damage on a success, double damage on a critical failure).
